sloka: धनुर्वेदे च निरतः पितुः शुशॄषणे रतः ।बाल्यात् प्रभृति सुस्निग्धो लक्ष्मणो लक्ष्मि वर्धनः ॥१-१८-२८॥
transliteration: dhanurvede ca nirataḥ pituḥ śuśṝṣaṇe rataḥ ।bālyāt prabhṛti susnigdho lakṣmaṇo lakṣmi vardhanaḥ ॥1-18-28॥

translations.english: Lakshmana, possessed of fortune, was the dearest to his brother than his own body. As though he was his life without.
